result.topic_en: A Latin draft note stating that the differential of a function differs from the value of a series $a_0 + a_1 \ldots$ by less than any given quantity, a result to be credited to Abel, from which a theorem follows easily (with a reference to Dirichlet, 1852 Sept. 14).
result.transcription:
differentiam functionis fit a valore seriei
$a_0+a_1$ ......
infra quantitatem quamvis datam descendere.

methods.what: Statement that the difference between a function and the value of the series $a_0+a_1+\ldots$ can be made smaller than any given quantity (Abel's theorem on power series, as attributed via Dirichlet)
methods.quote:
differentiam functionis fit a valore seriei
$a_0+a_1$ ......
infra quantitatem quamvis datam descendere.

items.english: From this theorem, which the most illustrious Dirichlet (1852 Sept. 14), when the preceding had already been written, pointed out is to be attributed to the illustrious Abel, it is easily deduced.
